Why Eyelid Surgery is Popular for Men

Men, like women, can experience droopy or puffy eyelids due to aging, genetics, or lifestyle factors. Male blepharoplasty addresses these concerns by removing or repositioning excess skin, fat, and muscle, resulting in a more defined and rejuvenated appearance. This procedure can improve self-confidence and help you look as energetic and vibrant as you feel.

The Male Blepharoplasty Procedure in Cincinnati, OH

At AestheticEye, our surgeons utilize advanced techniques to ensure optimal outcomes for male blepharoplasty. The procedure involves:

Upper Eyelid Surgery

For the upper eyelids, an incision is made along the natural crease to remove or reposition excess skin, muscle, and fat. This creates a smoother, more lifted appearance.

Lower Eyelid Surgery

For the lower eyelids, an incision is made just below the lash line or inside the eyelid to remove or reposition excess fat and skin, reducing puffiness and smoothing the area.

The choice of technique will depend on your specific concerns and aesthetic goals, which will be thoroughly discussed during your consultation.

Recovery and Results from Oculoplastic Experts

Recovery from male blepharoplasty is generally smooth, with most patients experiencing mild swelling and bruising for the first week or two. Cold compresses and prescribed medications can help manage these symptoms. Most patients return to their normal activities within 10-14 days. The final results, which can be seen as swelling subsides, include a more youthful and rejuvenated appearance.

Frequently Asked Questions | Male Blepharoplasty

What Makes Male Blepharoplasty Different from Female Blepharoplasty?

Male blepharoplasty is tailored to preserve and enhance masculine features, focusing on subtle changes that result in a natural and refreshed look without feminizing the appearance.

Am I a Good Candidate for Male Blepharoplasty?

Ideal candidates are men who are in good overall health and have concerns about droopy or puffy eyelids. A consultation with our surgeons will determine if blepharoplasty is right for you.

How Long Do the Results of Male Blepharoplasty Last?

The results of male blepharoplasty are long-lasting, often providing a more youthful appearance for many years. However, the natural aging process will continue, and maintenance treatments may be needed over time.

Is the Procedure Painful?

The procedure itself is performed under anesthesia, so patients do not feel pain during surgery. Post-operative discomfort is usually minimal and can be managed with prescribed pain medication.

Can Male Blepharoplasty Be Combined with Other Procedures?

Yes, male blepharoplasty can be combined with other facial procedures, such as brow lifts or injectables, to achieve more comprehensive rejuvenation.

What Are the Risks Associated with Male Blepharoplasty?

As with any surgical procedure, there are potential risks, including infection, bleeding, and complications related to anesthesia. These risks are minimized when the surgery is performed by experienced oculoplastic surgeons like Dr. Henson and Dr. Pargament at AestheticEye.
